description: Cut one Helvetica line so it fits a width, ending with an ellipsis (…) when the text is too long. The ellipsis is the WinAnsi character. If the whole line already fits, it is returned unchanged. If even the ellipsis is wider than the measure, the call is rejected. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/text-ellipsis
name: text_ellipsis
title: Text Ellipsis
